Latin word

utcumque

adverb; utcumque est (erit), however that is (will be)

however it is, whatever happens; however, in whatever way

In this lexicon

  • anyway

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. praef. 3: utcumque erit, juvābit tamen; Traupman 287

  • however

    also used · classical · Liv. praef. 3: utcumque erit, juvābit tamen

Examples

  • Sed utut haec sunt, tamen hoc faciam.

    But however that may be, this is what I’ll do anyway.Ter. Ph. 531

    In the entry for anyway

  • quō diē veniēs, utique cum tuīs apud mē sīs

    whichever day you come, stay with me in any case, with your familyCic. Att. 4.4.1

    In the entry for anyway

  • utcumque erit, juvābit tamen

    however it turns out, I shall still be glad of itLiv. praef. 3
